inj.note: Since Watson reported concussion symptoms Tuesday, he didn't practice Wednesday and Thursday before being limited Friday and earning a questionable tag for Week 9 action. Head coach Todd Monken relayed to reporters the Browns' official site Friday that Shedeur Sanders will be the team's starting quarterback Sunday, so some possibilities for Watson this weekend are active as the backup or inactive as the emergency third QB.

news.h: Browns QB Deshaun Watson out of concussion protocol
news.d: Browns QB Deshaun Watson is out of the concussion protocol, but he is questionable. Shedeur Sanders will get the start against the Saints.

news.h: Browns to start Sanders at QB vs. Saints with Watson in protocol
news.d: The Browns will start Shedeur Sanders at quarterback against the Saints as Deshaun Watson remains in the concussion protocol.

news.h: Browns QB Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol; status vs. Saints unclear
news.d: The Browns have placed starting QB Deshaun Watson in the concussion protocol, leaving his status for Sunday's matchup against the Saints in question.
